title: Tiresias Appears to Ulysses during the Sacrifice
note: Watercolour, Albertina, Vienna (The Yorck Project image). Eliot's note on l. 218: 'Tiresias, although a mere spectator and not indeed a "character", is yet the most important personage in the poem'.
